youtube_title: Jesus... Why Am I Always The Last To Know? | John 15:15 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus... they all went out tonight. I found out from her story. 😔

Tonight her whole friend group went out without telling her, and she found out from a story.

She: Jesus... they all went out tonight. I found out from her story. 😔

She: The group chat I've been in since first year. Nobody even typed my name.

Jesus: You opened that story four times before you closed the app. I watched every one with you.

She: Did I do something wrong? Why did nobody just tell me?

Jesus: Their silence is about their plans, not your worth. Overlooked is not erased.

She: But I showed up for all of them. Their birthdays, their 2 a.m. calls.

Jesus: I know. None of that faithfulness is wasted because they forgot it tonight.

She: It just hurts that the people closest to me made me feel optional.

Jesus: You have never been optional to Me. I kept a seat no group chat can remove.

Jesus: They can leave you off a plan. They cannot leave you off My list.

"I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his master’s business. Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you."
John 15:15 (NIV)

You have never been optional to Me. I kept a seat no group chat can remove.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered in His words.

When did you last feel like the extra one? 💔 Tell us in the comments.
